remarks: Welcome 392 Marilla, this large and well-maintained duplex offering three bedrooms and one full bathroom in each unit. Both apartments feature spacious layouts with a large living room and separate dining room, providing plenty of room for comfortable living. This property is an excellent opportunity for an investor looking to add a solid rental property to their portfolio or for an owner-occupant looking to live in one unit while renting out the other to help offset the mortgage. 392 Marilla features vinyl replacement windows throughout, while the roof and mechanical systems have been updated within the past 10 years, helping keep future maintenance costs lower. The lower unit has been thoughtfully updated with fresh paint throughout, an updated kitchen, and a beautifully refreshed bathroom. The upper unit also features a refreshed bathroom, adding to the overall appeal and functionality of the property. With two generously sized units, strong layouts, and important major components already updated, this duplex offers both flexibility and long-term investment potential. Whether you're looking to expand your rental portfolio or house-hack your next property, this is an opportunity worth taking a look at!
